classification: proposed internal acceptance criteria; not NFL facts, empirical results, legal advice, or evidence that a gate has passed

criteria.number: 100% mapped; 0 uncatalogued asks
criteria.criterion: Reconcile every distinct request in the brief to a stable R- or SG-series ID with status, owner/scope, blocking gate, source or an explicit UNVERIFIED marker. No request is silently omitted or merged without a recorded cross-reference.
criteria.basis: Proposed coverage threshold; the current R-series catalogue is dated 2026-11-12.

criteria.number: 100% checks pass; 0 broken local links
criteria.criterion: Every published page is reachable; all local links/assets resolve; every table row has a primary-source link or is explicitly blank and flagged unverified; responsive build checks pass.
criteria.basis: Proposed site QA threshold.

criteria.number: 100% proposals reviewable; 0 unreviewed changes auto-applied
criteria.criterion: Each proposed site/model change shows dependencies, benefits, costs/risks, source context and a review state. An implementation requires an explicit recorded decision; an unreviewed proposal cannot silently become a live feature.
criteria.basis: Proposed governance threshold; a human decision is intentionally not automated.

criteria.number: 100% questions have known / missing / discovery fields
criteria.criterion: Every open question distinguishes verified facts from missing answers, provides a discovery action and cites the primary source or is marked UNVERIFIED. Empty answers are never rendered as confirmed.
criteria.basis: Proposed completeness threshold.

criteria.number: 100% of originated market rows have permissioned open + close quotes
criteria.criterion: Before a numeric line is scored, store a licensed source, market key, quote, book/consensus policy, UTC capture time, opening/closing designation and applicable settlement/void rules. If any is absent, the market line and residual remain blank and the strategy stays blocked.
criteria.basis: Proposed data gate; no price vendor, terms, or price history is verified in the current register.

criteria.number: n ≥ 100 minimum; 95% cluster-CI lower bound > 0; q ≤ 0.05
criteria.criterion: Pre-register each model/strategy and all trials before evaluation. The existing engine minimum is 100 graded bets, but the final sample must also be power-justified; require benchmark-relative proper-score skill with a game-cluster 95% lower confidence bound above zero and multiplicity-adjusted q ≤ 0.05. Keep parlays/prop combos blocked until G07 clears.
criteria.basis: Mixed: n≥100, 95% uncertainty and q≤0.05 appear in existing repository gates; applying proper-score skill here is a proposed rule. The minimum alone is not proof of adequate power.

criteria.number: 0 monetary awards until all applicable gates and funding are verified
criteria.criterion: Award only to strategies that pass every applicable data, pre-registration, out-of-sample, dependence and prospective gate. Publish a verified funding amount, eligibility rule and jurisdiction/compliance sign-off first; until then, rewards are non-monetary or blank.
criteria.basis: Proposed fail-closed reward policy; amount and legal status are unverified.

criteria.number: 10/10 applicable gates passed; 0 failed gates
criteria.criterion: A strategy may be called eligible only after every applicable G01-G10 test passes on verified data. Synthetic tests demonstrate code behavior only and do not count as NFL performance evidence.
criteria.basis: Uses the ten-gate count in the canonical register; all thresholds are still applied per strategy and market type.

criteria.number: n printed for every value; 2+ seasons before combo eligibility
criteria.criterion: Estimate correlations only from officially sourced, matched outcomes; publish pair definition, game-level n, interval and source. For combo eligibility, retain the existing line-lab proposal of at least two seasons per correlation cluster and verify the joint probability on held-out games. Without the evidence, leave rho/joint probabilities blank.
criteria.basis: The 2-season minimum is an existing proposed gate in line-lab; no official prop sample currently clears it.

criteria.number: BSS > 0; game-cluster 95% CI lower bound > 0; q ≤ 0.05
criteria.criterion: Compare each frozen strategy with a named control using proper scores; report the game-cluster uncertainty interval and correct for all registered trials. Describe unexplained residual as uncertainty, not as pure luck or proven skill.
criteria.basis: Proposed skill qualification; the existing registration requires family-wise multiplicity handling and uncertainty.

criteria.number: 32/32 clubs; at least 1 immutable capture per source per day from Wed to kickoff
criteria.criterion: For every scheduled report day, store each available official NFL report and club source with UTC observed-at time, raw SHA-256, parser/schema version and conflict status. Count explicit no-report/no-injury sections; never equate absence from a report with availability.
criteria.basis: Proposed coverage/freshness threshold based on the requested daily Wed-to-kickoff cadence; this does not establish source reuse rights.

criteria.number: 32/32 clubs have a verified depth route or an explicitly approved alternative
criteria.criterion: Verify the official club depth page or an official snap-count route for every club before using the feature. Preserve shared/empty slots and raw values. Actual starters/game-day status require official Game Books or inactive evidence; do not substitute jersey number, experience, salary or a published rank.
criteria.basis: Proposed complete-coverage gate; source routes and permission remain unverified for some clubs.

criteria.number: 100% of executive findings carry status, caveat and source
criteria.criterion: The summary must distinguish completed work, unverified values, data blockers, model results and proposed next actions; every empirical claim is linked or blank and flagged.
criteria.basis: Proposed editorial completeness threshold.

criteria.number: 100% of scheduled data jobs logged; 0 manual data entry in the data pipeline
criteria.criterion: Capture, hashing, validation, freshness monitoring, build and publication run unattended and emit a retained success/failure record. Do not automate or invent data contracts, budget, licensing or jurisdiction decisions; keep those as explicit blockers.
criteria.basis: Proposed operations threshold. External rights/funding decisions cannot be resolved by automation.

criteria.number: 100% source coverage or explicit blank + UNVERIFIED; 0 unsupported values
criteria.criterion: Every factual table value has a first-party source link and a capture/as-of context. If the value cannot be confirmed, leave it blank, mark it unverified and add it to Flagged for Review. Byte hashes alone do not prove source authority or reuse rights.
criteria.basis: Proposed audit threshold; the independent repository audit still records exceptions.

criteria.number: 0 overlapping in-progress file scopes
criteria.criterion: Each task has a unique owner, status and file scope in COORDINATION.md. Rebase before push, preserve upstream changes on conflict and record handoffs; never change the Arena-fixed branch.
criteria.basis: Proposed coordination invariant.

criteria.number: 0 failed required checks; at least 1 successful deploy of the reviewed commit
criteria.criterion: The PR validation, root/subsite link checks and post-merge Pages deployment all pass; the deployed URL returns the reviewed content. Keep known publisher-race or workflow warnings visible rather than treating them as a passing gate.
criteria.basis: Proposed publication threshold; the previous deployment record is historical, not proof of this commit's deploy.

criteria.number: 100% unmatched report rows have a reason; 0 unexplained joins
criteria.criterion: Every report row is either exact-matched to dated club evidence or retained as unmatched with a specific reason. Never infer a replacement to fill a gap; rerun after the Texans/Packers parser issues are resolved and re-verified.
criteria.basis: Proposed data-integrity threshold; previously published counts are tied to an older capture.

criteria.number: 100% of scheduled matchup clubs accounted for; 32/32 in the league-wide sweep
criteria.criterion: For each game week, every club in the official schedule has a report row or explicit official no-injury section. Before any team-level model is trusted, complete the separate roster/IR source sweep across all 32 clubs and report coverage and exceptions.
criteria.basis: Proposed completeness threshold; matchup coverage and all-club roster coverage are distinct checks.

criteria.number: 100% of actual-status fields have official game-day evidence; 0 inferred active states
criteria.criterion: Use official NFL Game Books and official inactive/active evidence for actual starters and game-day status, only after source authority and reuse rights are verified. Preserve injury designation as a separate dated field. Missing or conflicting evidence remains blank/flagged; a blank injury status is not active.
criteria.basis: Proposed authority threshold; registered S03 documents injury-status categories, not game-day participation. The linked policy source does not itself verify status; a complete, reusable game-day feed has not been established.

criteria.number: 100% shared/empty slots retained; 0 collapsed multi-player rank-1 slots
criteria.criterion: Represent a club's published slot as a group (including multiple players or no player) and retain position/unit/source/date. No downstream feature may silently convert a shared rank-1 cell to a unique starter.
criteria.basis: Proposed schema invariant.

criteria.number: 100% of fields compared or marked unreachable; 0 unreachable sources counted as pass
criteria.criterion: Re-fetch every supported published field, compare exact row/field values and expose drift, missing rows, extra rows and unreachable sources. A source outage or schema change fails closed and cannot render as a clean blank.
criteria.basis: Proposed verification threshold; the latest recorded status is an offline/structural artifact, not a fresh live comparison.

criteria.number: 100% of proposals show trade-off, dependency, source and review state
criteria.criterion: Before implementation, a reviewer can compare benefits, costs, risks, dependencies and a recommended path. No choice is inferred from browser state or treated as approval unless exported/recorded.
criteria.basis: Proposed reviewability threshold.

criteria.number: 100% of fixtures have official schedule/venue evidence or a blank flagged field
criteria.criterion: Transcribe venue and schedule context from the official NFL game centre/schedule, retain the dated schedule announcement, and version roster transactions against each depth capture. Do not attribute performance changes to travel, venue or personnel without dated evidence.
criteria.basis: Proposed fixture/provenance threshold; no performance effect is implied.

criteria.number: 0 empirical betting figures before permissioned prices + official grading are available
criteria.criterion: Keep fair-line, market-line, residual, ROI, CLV, probability, correlation and rewards blank or clearly non-empirical until source rights, quote timestamps, official settlement/grade rules and model inputs pass the applicable gates.
criteria.basis: Fail-closed publication rule; current market terms and historical price coverage are unverified.

criteria.number: 100% of candidate paths compare prerequisites, cost, benefit and risk
criteria.criterion: Each route to the next phase has comparable prerequisites, estimated cost/effort, benefits, risks and a review decision field. Implement only the chosen, recorded path; leaving a choice open does not block research-only publication.
criteria.basis: Proposed decision-readiness threshold; cost figures remain blank unless sourced.
